verses.1: And Moses called out to all Israel, saying, “Have you seen all that Jehovah has done before your eyes in Egypt for Pharaoh and all his servants and all his land?”
verses.2: The great ships that your eyes have seen, and the huge monsters they were.
verses.3: And Jehovah has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, or ears to hear, until this day.
verses.4: And I will go with you for forty years in the desert. Your clothes will not be torn apart from on them, and your feet will not be worn out from walking in the desert.
verses.5: You have not eaten bread, nor have you drunk wine as a offering to me. So that you may know that I, the LORD your God, am indeed your God.
verses.6: And they came to that place. Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of the Moabites, went out to meet us to fight against us. And we defeated them.
verses.7: And their land was taken away, and it was given as a possession to Reuben, Gad, and the half of Manasseh.
verses.8: And you shall keep the words of this covenant, and do them, so that you may know all that you shall do.
verses.9: Today, you all stand before Yahweh your God. Your heads, your knees, your old age, and your children—all of Israel’s people.
verses.10: May you be saved from this situation, and may your crops be protected from destruction by those who are near your storehouses. May they not destroy your crops.
verses.11: May the covenant of Jehovah your God be with you, and may His strength be your strength today.
verses.12: So that today, you may be established as a people. And he will become your God, just as it was said to you. And just as it was promised to your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.13: And not just for yourselves alone, I will establish this covenant and these laws.
verses.14: For those who are with us today, they stand before our God, Jehovah. But those who are not with us today… they also stand before our God.
verses.15: For you know what it was to dwell in the land of Egypt, and what it was to pass through the lands that you have crossed.
verses.16: And they saw their crowns and their robes made of gold and silver, along with wood and stone.
verses.17: If you have any man, woman, family member, or servant whose heart is inclined to go and serve the gods of those nations today, instead of serving our God. Then you must have a pure heart and be willing to obey Him.
verses.18: And when he heard these words, he was filled with joy. He said, “May peace be upon me! For in my heart I will go to carry out the plan of God.”
verses.19: The LORD will not forgive him, for then the LORD will become angry with this man. His anger will be great, just as it is written in this book. The LORD will destroy his name from under heaven.
verses.20: And Jehovah distinguished it from all the other tribes of Israel. It was like all those curses written in the Book of the Law.
verses.21: And the next generation said to you, “Those who come from afar will see the land and its ruins. They will also see the destruction that Jehovah has brought upon it.”
verses.22: Gaphrit and salt will burn all its land. No plants will be able to grow there, nor will any crops produce fruit. The land will become barren and useless. Even the animals that God created will be destroyed by His fire and flames.
verses.23: And all the nations said, “What has Jehovah done to this land? What is this great disaster that He has brought upon it?”
verses.24: And they said, “They have broken the covenant of Yahweh, the God of their ancestors. He broke that covenant when he brought them out of Egypt.”
verses.25: And they went and served other gods. They worshiped those gods whom they didn’t know, and who had no share in their lives.
verses.26: And Jehovah struck that land, in order to bring upon it all the curses written in that book.
verses.27: And Jehovah poured out upon their land fire, smoke, and great heat. He sent them into another land, just as it is today.
verses.28: Those things that are hidden from our God, and those things that are revealed to us, will be done forever, so that all the words of this Torah may be fulfilled.
